lines.text: The chief priests and scribes feared the people, and Judas agreed with the chief priests to betray Jesus for money.
On the day the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed, Jesus sent Peter and Andrew to prepare the Passover.
Jesus told them to follow a man carrying a jug of water to a house with a large upper room.
Jesus reclined with His apostles and said He had eagerly desired to eat this Passover with them before the Sabbath.
Jesus gave bread as His body, called the cup the new covenant, and said His betrayer was at the table.
